name: Own-savings standing order to a saver that is not connected (Savings category, no learned destination), two other current accounts with room (G434)

expected.notes: G434 (Kevin 2026-11-07, production). Today Wed 25 Nov 2026, pay period last Friday, so payday is Fri 27 Nov and the window is 25 and 26 Nov. Chase Current A holds 150 and carries one standing order of 300 dated Thu 26 Nov into a savings account that is NOT one of the user's connected accounts, so no destination was ever learned; the series carries the built-in Savings category, which is what marks it as own savings. Barclays Current B holds 600 and Monzo Current C holds 200, nothing due on either. A: 150 - 300 = -150 after payments and at the low point, so the walk verdict is short. The only bounced item is the savings order, so it is never a payment at risk: at risk count 0, and there is no payment gap, the whole 150 is savings at risk (amber). Cover target = ceil5(150) + 10 cushion = 160. B headroom = 600 - 10 = 590 and C headroom = 200 - 10 = 190, so B alone covers it: one move of 160 from B to A (fewest sources, most headroom). Earmarks: B set aside 160, Spend from 600 - 160 = 440; C untouched, Spend from 200. A short after cover = max(0, 150 - 160) = 0 and carries the savings at risk fact (amount 150, covered). Left to spend: the pool is the three counted current accounts 150 + 600 + 200 = 950; with no learned destination the 300 still leaves the pool, so 950 - 300 = 650. Allocation: B 440 + C 200 + A 10 (its cushion, spendable only after the suggested move) = 650 exactly. Nothing is moved by the app: the card is a recommendation. The payday plan stays null (G402).
